match_guests.description: Members add up to 2 guests to an announcement (specs 005/006). Leave the in-app default to keep the spec 013 PRE/PRO default; add a conditional value per app (Squadfy * Dev / Prod) to switch it remotely.

schedule_exceptions.description: Cancel or move one week of the weekly schedule (spec 004). Leave the in-app default to keep the spec 013 PRE/PRO default; add a conditional value per app (Squadfy * Dev / Prod) to switch it remotely.

custom_draw_time.description: Configurable announcement close and team draw times (spec 004). Leave the in-app default to keep the spec 013 PRE/PRO default; add a conditional value per app (Squadfy * Dev / Prod) to switch it remotely.

manual_score.description: Enter the final score manually instead of from goal events (spec 007). Leave the in-app default to keep the spec 013 PRE/PRO default; add a conditional value per app (Squadfy * Dev / Prod) to switch it remotely.

member_absences.description: Members register absence periods that withdraw them from open announcements (spec 014). Leave the in-app default to keep the spec 013 PRE/PRO default; add a conditional value per app (Squadfy * Dev / Prod) to switch it remotely.

chat.description: User-to-user chat (hidden on iOS in PRO until report/block exist, D-13). Leave the in-app default to keep the spec 013 PRE/PRO default; add a conditional value per app (Squadfy * Dev / Prod) to switch it remotely.

account_deletion.description: Delete the account from Profile with the password (spec 011, backend spec 010). Leave the in-app default to keep the spec 013 PRE/PRO default; add a conditional value per app (Squadfy * Dev / Prod) to switch it remotely.

dev_test_match.description: Button to create a test match with an immediate sign-up window. Leave the in-app default to keep the spec 013 PRE/PRO default; add a conditional value per app (Squadfy * Dev / Prod) to switch it remotely.
